Sacred Steps Echoes of Nritya

A journey of Ranjana Mahesh through the grace and spirit of Indian classical dance.

A Prayer in Motion

On 23 August 2026, Ranjana Mahesh presented a Kuchipudi performance for the Onam celebrations at the Mata Amritanandamayi Math in Trivandrum.

The recital brought together two devotional compositions: Lambodara and Pibare Rama Rasam. Through expressive storytelling and graceful movement, the performance celebrated devotion and the joyful spirit of Onam.

Onam in Sacred Rhythm

On 15 August 2026, Ranjana Mahesh brought the grace and expressive storytelling of Kuchipudi to an Onam celebration at the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple in Trivandrum.

The programme unfolded as a devotional journey through four compositions: Lambodara Lakumikara, Pooja Dance, Pibare Rama Rasam, and Sri Vighnarajam Bhaje. Set against the temple’s sacred atmosphere, each piece wove together rhythm, expression, and devotion.

A Welcome in Rhythm

On 21 April 2025, Ranjana Mahesh performed Kuchipudi as part of the ceremonial welcome for U.S. Vice President JD Vance during his visit to India at Indira Gandhi International Airport, Terminal 1, in New Delhi.

The presentation featured a Jathiswaram, combining rhythmic precision, graceful movement, and the vibrant energy of Indian classical dance to mark the occasion.

Shiva: An Invocation in Motion

On 17 April 2025, at Renaissance 2025, presented by the Lightsense Art Foundation at the India Habitat Centre in New Delhi, Ranjana Mahesh performed Shivashtakam in the Kuchipudi tradition.

The presentation brought the devotional verses of Shivashtakam to life through rhythmic movement, expressive gesture, and storytelling.

The Divine Nectar

On 6 January 2025, at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, Ranjana Mahesh performed in The Divine Nectar, a Kuchipudi production presented as part of Grameen Bharat Mahotsav.

Organised by the Department of Financial Services, Government of India, the festival celebrated the theme Harvest – Rhythms of Earth, bringing together artistic traditions rooted in India's cultural heritage.

Ardhashankaram

On 22 November 2024, at the India Habitat Centre in New Delhi, Ranjana Mahesh performed in Ardhashankaram, a Kuchipudi production choreographed by Dr. Vasanth Kiran.

The production explored its theme through the expressive vocabulary of Kuchipudi, combining rhythmic movement, gesture, and storytelling.

Rhapsody: Endangered Creativity in the Time of AI

On 13 November 2024, at Ramagya School in Greater Noida, Ranjana Mahesh served as a judge for the dance competition Rhapsody.

The programme was centred on the theme Endangered Creativity in the Time of AI, exploring creativity and artistic expression in an era increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence.

Navaratri Programme

On 12 October 2024, at the Durgotsav Pandal in CR Park, New Delhi, Ranjana Mahesh presented a Kuchipudi performance as part of the Navaratri celebrations.

The performance formed part of the festive cultural programme, bringing the expressive and rhythmic traditions of Kuchipudi to the Navaratri stage.
